_evidence: FINAL mapping for the Asianomist legacy import (asn-launch W2). No site id, no image host: those live in the owner-held overlay ~/asn-private/overlay.json. Decided 05-11-26 by the owner (approved the proposals) from the discovery result (01-discover-asn.sql run in the globaltravelpost SQL Editor 05-11-26: site asianomist, name Asianomist (id in the overlay only), exactly 1 match, 14 sites in the DB; 1997 rows = 1435 published, 463 archived (461 never published), 99 draft, no scheduled or rejected rows; created_at 2026-08-03 to 2026-11-05, 1996/1997 with non-zero microseconds, 0 duplicate instants; the newest published_at is 2026-11-05, so the old site is still publishing; 0 null, duplicate or bad slugs; section and subsection values are SLUGS; published rows by old section: the-brief 91 (morning-brief 65, week-ahead 13, weekend-read 13), economies 191 (southeast-asia 102, india-south-asia 36, japan-korea 29, asia-world 20, china 3, greater-china 1), markets 424 (stocks-bonds 148, central-banks-currencies 89, markets-today 88, ipo-deals 78, crypto-digital-assets 19, empty subsection 2), banking-fintech 202 (banks 100, payments-lending 81, insurtech-wealthtech 21), industries 464 (tech-semiconductors 135, real-estate-infrastructure 131, consumer-retail 82, energy-commodities 62, supply-chain 52, empty subsection 2), wealth 63 (investing 49, property-investment 8, expat-money 5, empty subsection 1); no columns-explainers, press-room or wealth/savings-rates rows; 1940 featured images on the old Supabase storage host, 57 none or relative; 7837 body sections, 0 body images; 6861 distinct legacy tags (13024 uses on 1997 rows); 0 media_assets rows for this site (7554 for all sites)). (1) status: published only (1435 at discovery); archived, draft, scheduled, rejected are SKIP; catch-up runs before cutover pick up what the old site publishes after the first run. (2) categories: legacy subsections equal to a new sub-section slug pass through 1:1 (the-brief week-ahead, weekend-read; economies southeast-asia, china, japan-korea, india-south-asia, asia-world; markets markets-today, central-banks-currencies, stocks-bonds, ipo-deals, crypto-digital-assets; industries supply-chain, tech-semiconductors, energy-commodities, consumer-retail, real-estate-infrastructure); economies/greater-china goes to economies/china; the-brief/morning-brief goes to the-brief with NO sub-section (Morning Brief is a the-brief article without sub-section); the legacy banking-fintech subsections (banks, payments-lending, insurtech-wealthtech) and wealth subsections (investing, savings-rates, property-investment, expat-money) go to their pillar with NO sub-section (the new design has none there); an empty subsection (NULL or empty string: the industries, markets and wealth rows above) resolves through <pillar>/* to the pillar with no sub-section (resolveTaxonomy tries <section>/<sub>, then <section> when sub is empty, then <section>/*); every pillar keeps that <pillar>/* fallback. For catch-up runs: columns-explainers/columns goes to columns, columns-explainers/explainers to explainers, columns/* and explainers/* to their pillar, press-room/* to press-room with no sub-section (single-home); columns-explainers with an empty or unknown subsection has NO entry on purpose (it cannot be split by rule): such a published row is not imported (the import report lists it as reject: unmapped-category) and verify fails until the owner picks columns or explainers. (3) authors: even split over the 6 staff names of the Team page (mode even: deterministic, rows ordered by publication date then legacy id, per-author counts differ by at most 1, like agr/amb: 1435 rows = 240 + 5 x 239); legacy bylines are not kept; catch-up runs keep the Central author of rows already imported. (4) tags: only the 6 approved tags survive (china-plus-one-tracker, chart-of-the-day, central-banks, ipo, supply-chain, asean); a legacy tag is kept only when its slug equals one of them (the discovery's top 40 has supply-chain 33, ipo 32 and central-banks 29 uses, all statuses); every other legacy tag is dropped; no renames. (5) media: featured images are downloaded into the tenant's Central Media (R2); media.bodyImages drop (none exist); the old image library has no rows for this site, so nothing goes to the content-engine Media Engine. (6) not migrated (owner): newsletter subscribers, press submissions and logs; the mapping cannot read them anyway (tableAllowList is articles, sites, site_authors). (7) archivedAs: section (301 to the article section page, not 410), as agr/amb; archived rows are SKIP anyway. (8) body: reflowMaxChars 380 as aer/agr/amb (same legacy platform: each section is stored as one block and split into paragraphs at render time). Old origin is the apex https://asianomist.com (www.asianomist.com is an alias), article path /article/{slug}, section paths are the old pillars /the-brief, /economies, /markets, /banking-fintech, /industries, /wealth, /columns-explainers, /press-room. Pages and old paths get no rule from this mapping (as agr/amb: extraLegacyPaths and gonePaths stay empty): asianomist-web hand-writes /studio 301 /advertise, /data 301 /markets, /columns-explainers 301 /columns, /press-room-submit 301 /press-room/submit and the legacy sub-section paths at cutover.
